profile_text.body:
Cerence Inc. is a public company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, and listed on SEC EDGAR under CIK 0001768267 with the ticker CRNC. On its own site the company describes itself as delivering trusted physical AI through voice, multimodal understanding, contextual intelligence, and agentic architecture, proven at automotive scale and built for intelligent systems across industries. It says its platform combines voice, multimodal understanding, contextual intelligence, agentic architecture, and governed execution so people can communicate naturally with vehicles, machines, and other intelligent systems.

The site describes an agentic cockpit that coordinates specialized agents, vehicle context, and governance for in-car outcomes, and an ecosystem of specialized agents that share context and communicate through Agent2Agent protocols, with guardrails and privacy controls and a flexible cloud, edge, or hybrid architecture. Named offerings include Cerence xUI, described as a multimodal AI foundation that helps OEMs combine speech, vision, and vehicle data to understand driver intent, and Cerence Emergency Vehicle Detection (EVD), which the company says is already deployed in production vehicles and can detect and localize more than 1,500 emergency sirens across nearly 50 countries, from more than 300 meters away with interior microphones and beyond 800 meters with exterior microphones. The site also states that Cerence AI reported third quarter results with revenue up 12% YoY, connected services revenue up 20% YoY, and operating cash flow of $20M supporting a first-ever share repurchase program, and it describes work with Microsoft on Zero Trust and layered AI security for in-car assistants.

The available record contains no lawsuits or MCP servers for the company, and no tracked products beyond what the site itself describes.
